title: Anticybercrime body sets deadline for Reddit, Discord

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — An attached agency of the Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) has given two online platforms a deadline in establishing their presence in the country and coordinating with authorities, as the government tries to determine the extent of social media’s influence following a third school shooting in three months.
